entries.logic: Uses unquoted Heredocs (<<EOF) to allow shell variable expansion during the generation process. Essential for including dynamic timestamps, project names, and author metadata.
entries.rationale: Allows for highly customized and context-aware file generation with zero external templating dependencies.

entries.logic: When generating a script that must contain its own shell variables, use backslash escaping (\$) within a dynamic Heredoc to prevent premature expansion.
entries.implementation:
cat > script.sh <<EOF
CURRENT_DIR=\$(pwd)
echo "Dir is \$CURRENT_DIR"
EOF
entries.rationale: Crucial for generating operational scripts that need to reference environment variables at runtime rather than at generation time.
